nodes.description: Private owner address of SCC; privileged role checked in init, _mints, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate and ensure.
Public mapping of token balances mutated in transferFrom, batchSend, _mints and constructor without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances mutated in transferFrom, approve and constructor.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping used as a whitelist in ensure and set in _mints.
Private minimum sale amount, set in init and checked in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set in init and checked in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, set in init and checked in condition.
Private whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate controlling who may transfer; whitelists owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view helper enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address and data.
Owner-or-backdoor-address mint function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the address.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batched send with unchecked multiplication and looped balance additions.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Constructor minting initial supply to msg.sender and setting owner and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, approvals and transfers.
Low-level delegatecall on an arbitrary target with arbitrary calldata inside delegate.
Unchecked subtraction of balances and allowances (balanceOf[_from] -= _value, allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value).
Unchecked addition of balances (balanceOf[_to] += _value, balanceOf[_to] += total).
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into transferFrom from transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender for allowance checks and updates in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender is compared against owner before the delegatecall.
msg.sender is checked against owner and a hardcoded backdoor address in _mints.
msg.sender is required to equal owner in init.
msg.sender is required to equal owner and supplies the balance debited in batchSend.
msg.sender is required to equal owner in setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
transfer delegates to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass.
ensure falls back to condition when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure reads owner for the whitelist branch.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist condition.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist condition.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale limits.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the sale count limit.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
delegate performs a delegatecall on caller-supplied target and data, allowing arbitrary state takeover.
delegate gates the delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath, risking underflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked addition on balanceOf[_to], risking overflow.
batchSend subtracts an unchecked product total from balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend adds _value to balanceOf[_to] in a loop without overflow protection.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale parameters.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
_mints authorizes against owner or a hardcoded privileged address.

_value flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
